kind: bug / Graph / Tensor method keyword signature
title: Several Tensor method keyword arguments are rejected in Graph mode because standard_method uses different parameter names
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local Tensor signatures expose bitwise_left_shift(other), bitwise_right_shift(other), renorm(p, axis, maxnorm), float_power(other), multiply(value), and equal(other).
MindSpore 2.9 official Tensor API index links these Tensor methods, and the method pages/documented signatures use the public Tensor parameter names.
The same operations work in Graph mode when called positionally on CPU, so this is not an unsupported kernel issue.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: failures occur at Graph argument binding before numerical comparison.
Not an unsupported CPU issue: positional Graph controls succeed for every affected method.
Grouped as one issue because all six cases have the same root shape: Graph standard_method parameter names differ from the public Tensor method signatures.
